items.name: Ember Mantle
items.description: A charcoal cape that smoulders into molten orange at the hem, with embers that glow in the dark.

items.name: Hearthfire Cape
items.description: Living flames climb and flicker up from the hem, throwing off embers that rise and glow in the dark.

items.name: Tidal Weave
items.description: Deep-sea blue with rolling waves of foam and a sand-gold rope collar.

items.name: Riptide Cape
items.description: Waves roll across the cape for real: crests rise and fall, foam glitters and the water never stops moving.

items.name: Starlit Veil
items.description: A night sky with a violet nebula, a crescent moon and stars that shine in the dark.

items.name: Galaxy Flow Cape
items.description: A whole spiral galaxy on your back: its glowing arms slowly turn, star dust drifts and the stars twinkle.

items.name: Polar Lights Cape
items.description: Curtains of green, cyan and violet light ripple over snowy peaks, glowing softly in the dark.

items.name: Chevron Standard
items.description: A clean banner cape with three raised chevrons and a stitched hem, in any colour you like.

items.name: Checkered Rally
items.description: A rippling black-and-white chequered flag with a red stripe, for whoever crosses the line first.

items.name: Highland Plaid
items.description: A woven tartan cape with a fringed hem, in any colour you like.

items.name: Blossom Drift
items.description: A spring dusk with a branch of pink blossom and petals drifting down to the hem.

items.name: Pumpkin Night
items.description: A harvest moon, a flight of bats and a carved pumpkin whose face glows in the dark.

items.name: Frostfall Cloak
items.description: An icy blue cloak scattered with snowflakes, frost creeping up from the hem and a thick white fur collar.

items.name: Dragonhide Cape
items.description: Rows of raised emerald scales edged in gold, shading down to deep teal.

items.name: Neon Horizon
items.description: A striped sunset over a glowing neon grid, straight out of a retro arcade.

items.name: Oakheart Banner
items.description: A forest-green banner with a golden shield and a great oak, finished with a swallow-tail hem.

items.name: Sweetheart Cape
items.description: Rose-pink fading to crimson, scattered with hearts and finished with a lace-scalloped hem.

items.name: Aurora Wings
items.description: See-through wings that fade from cyan to violet, with glowing veins, a crystal spar and a slow, easy beat.

items.name: Pulse Wings
items.description: Energy wings with waves of light pulsing out from your shoulders to the tips, over and over.

items.name: Ashen Feathers
items.description: Layered grey feathers, each one separate, darkening towards tips that smoulder like embers.

items.name: Seraph Wings
items.description: Great white feathered wings, softly gilded at the tips, that sweep slowly behind you.

items.name: Wyrmspan Wings
items.description: Broad dragon wings: a crimson membrane with veins and bony fingers, scalloped edges and a hooked claw.

items.name: Infernal Wings
items.description: Spiked black demon wings whose veins glow like magma in the dark.

items.name: Stormcaller Wings
items.description: Storm-cloud wings that crackle with lightning: bolts flash across the membrane while the veins flicker.

items.name: Azure Butterfly Wings
items.description: Iridescent blue butterfly wings with black borders and white spots that flutter quickly.

items.name: Clockwork Wings
items.description: Riveted steel blades with brass trim and glowing blue seams, turning on a brass gear at each shoulder.

items.name: Glacier Wings
items.description: A fan of see-through ice crystals with glinting facets and frosted, glowing tips.

items.name: Comet Cap
items.description: A ribbed knit beanie with a turned-up cuff and a glowing pom-pom, in any colour you like.

items.name: Circuit Crown
items.description: A gold crown traced with glowing cyan circuitry, set with crystal gems and a tall crystal at the front.

items.name: Regal Crown
items.description: A classic gold crown with engraved scrollwork, a red velvet cap and a ruby, sapphire and emerald set in the band.

items.name: Sovereign Crown
items.description: A platinum crown whose ruby, sapphire, emerald and amethyst catch the light one after another, round and round.

items.name: Hollow Witch Hat
items.description: A tall, crooked violet witch hat with a wide brim and a gold-buckled band.

items.name: Party Cone
items.description: A striped, polka-dotted party hat worn at a jaunty angle, with a fluffy pink tuft on top.

items.name: Angel Halo
items.description: A softly glowing golden halo that floats above your head and bobs gently.

items.name: Orbit Halo
items.description: A radiant halo that spins above your head while a band of light races round the ring.

items.name: Ember Horns
items.description: A pair of ridged dark horns that curl up from your temples, glowing like coals at the tips.

items.name: Kitty Ears
items.description: Soft pointed cat ears with pink insides, in any colour you like.

items.name: Toadstool Cap
items.description: A round red mushroom cap with white spots and a frilled underside.

items.name: Dusk Visor
items.description: A sleek gunmetal visor across the eyes with a glowing red scanner slit and a woven strap.

items.name: Outlaw Bandana
items.description: A red printed bandana tied over the nose and mouth, knotted at the back with two loose tails.

items.name: Fox Spirit Mask
items.description: A white fox mask with red markings, pointed ears and a short snout, worn over the face.

items.name: Neon Shades
items.description: Wide sunglasses with a black frame and mirrored lenses that fade from pink to cyan and glow faintly.

items.name: Lantern Pack
items.description: A sturdy canvas backpack with a front pocket, leather straps, brass buckles, a rolled blanket and a little lantern that glows at night.

items.name: Runeblade
items.description: A broad steel sword slung across your back, its fuller carved with runes that glow cyan.

items.name: Rocket Jetpack
items.description: Twin red fuel tanks with hazard stripes and chrome nozzles that burn with a blue flame.

items.name: Ranger's Quiver
items.description: A tooled leather quiver with brass bands, slung across the back and stuffed with bright-fletched arrows.

items.name: Bastion Shield
items.description: A round wooden shield on your back, painted in blue and gold quarters with a steel rim and boss.

items.name: Ember Orbit
items.description: A ring of fire runes turns at your feet while three embers circle your waist.

items.name: Frost Sigil
items.description: A pale, branching frost star slowly turns beneath you, with a few drifting snowflakes.

items.name: Verdant Bloom
items.description: A wreath of glowing leaves and pink flowers turns slowly round your feet, with green motes in the air.

items.name: Void Rift
items.description: A violet rune circle with a dark, starry core opens under you, shedding motes of purple light.

items.name: Spectrum Aura
items.description: A rune circle whose colours sweep through the whole rainbow as it turns, with rainbow motes rising around you.

items.name: Mochi the Cat
items.description: A round ginger tabby with big green eyes and white paws that sits on your shoulder, looks about, blinks and swishes its tail.

items.name: Ember the Fox
items.description: A bright orange fox with a white chest, black socks and a big white-tipped tail that wags while it watches the world from your shoulder.

items.name: Hoot the Owl
items.description: A round brown owl with huge amber eyes, ear tufts and a speckled cream chest; it perches on your shoulder, blinks slowly and turns its head to look around.

items.name: Bubble the Slime
items.description: A wobbly see-through green slime with a glowing core, rosy cheeks and a goofy grin that bounces on your shoulder.

items.name: Pip the Wisp
items.description: A tiny friendly wisp of cool blue flame with big shiny eyes that floats beside your shoulder, waving its little hands, its flame flickering.

items.name: Mini Wyvern
items.description: A little teal dragon with violet wings, golden eyes and cream horns that hovers beside your shoulder, wings beating and tail swishing.

items.name: Prism Sprite
items.description: A tiny crystal fairy whose facets and wings shimmer through every colour while it flutters beside your shoulder.

items.name: Stardust Trail
items.description: Glittering violet and gold dust drifts from your feet as you move.

items.name: Ember Trail
items.description: Hot orange embers flicker up from your footsteps and fade to smoke.

items.name: Petal Trail
items.description: Soft pink and white blossom petals tumble along behind you.

items.name: Shatterburst
items.description: When you get a kill, crystal shards burst outward from where they fell.

items.name: Firework Pop
items.description: A kill sets off a bright firework of red, gold and blue sparks where they fell.

items.name: Soul Release
items.description: Pale blue wisps spiral up from where your opponent fell and drift away.

items.name: Victory Spiral
items.description: Win a game and two golden spirals climb around you, ending in a burst of sparks.

items.name: Confetti Cannon
items.description: Win a game and a cloud of rainbow confetti bursts out around you.

items.name: Starlight Fountain
items.description: Win a game and a tall column of white starlight spirals up around you.

items.name: Sunny Wave
items.description: A big, cheerful wave hello.

items.name: Drum Solo
items.description: Air drums: alternate hits with a head bob to the beat.

items.name: Crisp Salute
items.description: Stand to attention and snap off a sharp salute.

items.name: Slow Clap
items.description: A long, slow, meaningful round of applause.

items.name: Grand Bow
items.description: A theatrical bow with a flourish of the hand, for when you've earned the applause.

items.name: Nightglass Blade
items.description: Your sword, re-forged in faceted dark glass with a glowing violet core and a silver guard. Shows on swords you hold, on your screen.

items.name: Emberfang Saber
items.description: Your sword as a broad, notched saber whose edges glow like a forge, with a black iron guard and a ruby. Shows on swords you hold, on your screen.

items.name: Frostbite Edge
items.description: Your sword carved from clear blue ice, frosted along the edges, with crystal shards on the guard. Shows on swords you hold, on your screen.

items.name: Honeycomb Cape
items.description: Golden honeycomb cells, some full and some empty, with honey dripping from the collar.

items.name: Royal Ermine Cape
items.description: Crimson velvet with gold embroidery, a jewelled crown crest and a white ermine hem.

items.name: Pixel Camo Cape
items.description: Blocky camouflage in any colour you like.

items.name: Code Rain Cape
items.description: Columns of glowing green code stream down the cape and never stop.

items.name: Warp Speed Cape
items.description: Stars stream past from a violet core, like jumping to lightspeed.

items.name: Bass Drop Cape
items.description: A neon equalizer that bounces to a beat on your back.

items.name: Dusk Moth Wings
items.description: Soft, dusty moth wings in cream and bark brown, with a golden eye-spot on each.

items.name: Pro Headset
items.description: A gaming headset with glowing red rings on the cups and a mic by your mouth.

items.name: Dapper Top Hat
items.description: A tall black top hat with a crimson band and a gold buckle, worn at a tilt.

items.name: Raider Helm
items.description: A steel helmet with a bronze band, a nose guard and two curved horns.

items.name: Personal Raincloud
items.description: Your own little storm cloud: it rains on you nonstop, with the odd flash of lightning.

items.name: Aviator Goggles
items.description: Brass flying goggles with amber lenses on a worn leather strap.

items.name: Gentleman's Kit
items.description: A curled moustache and a gold monocle. Very distinguished.

items.name: Acoustic Guitar
items.description: A warm wooden guitar slung over your back on a black strap.

items.name: Turtle Shell
items.description: A big green turtle shell with pale plate lines. Slow and steady.

items.name: Reactor Pack
items.description: A steel backpack with a glowing plasma core that swirls and pulses.

items.name: Candy Cane Blade
items.description: Your sword as a striped peppermint candy cane with a gold guard. Shows on swords you hold, on your screen.

items.name: Verdant Thorn
items.description: Your sword grown from green glass, wrapped in a living vine with leaves. Shows on swords you hold, on your screen.

items.name: Plasma Edge
items.description: Your sword as a humming violet energy blade with light pulsing up the edge. Shows on swords you hold, on your screen.

items.name: Pebble the Penguin
items.description: A round little penguin with flippers out and a bright orange beak, riding on your shoulder.

items.name: Buzz the Bee
items.description: A fuzzy striped bee with see-through wings that hovers by your shoulder.

items.name: Lily the Frog
items.description: A bright green frog with golden eyes perched on your shoulder.

items.name: Boo the Ghost
items.description: A shy little ghost that flickers in and out, with glowing eyes that blink now and then.

items.name: Bubble Trail
items.description: Shiny soap bubbles float up from your footsteps and pop.

items.name: Heartbreaker
items.description: Your opponent bursts into a shower of pink and red hearts.

items.name: Gold Rush
items.description: Win a game and a fountain of gold coins and sparkles bursts out around you.

items.name: Facepalm
items.description: Bury your face in your hand. Sometimes it's all you can do.

items.name: Shrug
items.description: Arms out, shoulders up. Who knows?

items.name: Victory Flex
items.description: Both arms up, show the world those gains.

items.name: Torii Sunset Cape
items.description: A red gate standing in still water with the sun going down behind it, its reflection rippling on the lake.

items.name: Graffiti Crown Cape
items.description: Black cloth with a crown sprayed on in white, the paint still dripping, and a splash of colour underneath.

items.name: Imperial Dragon Cape
items.description: Deep navy silk with a long golden dragon coiling down it between curling clouds, chasing a pearl.

items.name: Ace of Spades Cape
items.description: A black playing card with a crimson double border, a big red spade in the middle and an ace in the corners.

items.name: Snow Peak Cape
items.description: A snowy mountain under a pale winter sky, pines along the shore, all mirrored in a still blue lake.

items.name: Winged Crest Cape
items.description: A golden eagle with its wings spread wide, set on black inside a fine gold border.

items.name: Crimson Samurai Cape
items.description: Deep crimson with gold edging, a round gold family crest of three swirls and gold waves rolling along the hem.

items.name: Glitch Koi Cape
items.description: Two neon koi, one pink and one cyan, chase each other round dark water while the signal glitches and tears.

items.name: Void Eye Cape
items.description: A great glowing eye in a swirling violet void. It looks one way, then the other, and every so often it blinks.

items.name: Origami Sakura Wings
items.description: Wings folded from pale pink paper, every panel creased sharp and printed with cherry blossoms.

items.name: Shadow Samurai Helm
items.description: A black-violet lacquered samurai helmet with a flared neck guard and a crescent crest that glows violet.

items.name: Storm Ring
items.description: A ring of crackling cyan lightning circles your waist and strikes again and again over a scorched ring at your feet.

items.name: Baby Capybara
items.description: A calm little capybara with a tiny citrus balanced on its head. It sits on your shoulder, blinks slowly and twitches its ears.

items.name: Panda Cub
items.description: A round panda cub with big eyes in dark patches that sits on your shoulder, looks about and blinks.

items.name: Bolt the Robot
items.description: A little hover robot with a screen for a face. Its pixel eyes blink, its chest light glows and its antenna blinks red while it floats beside your shoulder.

items.name: Steampunk Shark
items.description: A brass-plated little flying shark with goggle eyes and a toothy grin. A cog turns on its back as it swims through the air beside your shoulder.

items.name: Breakdance
items.description: Drop down, kick up into a handstand and spin round on your hands, legs scissoring, then flip back up.

items.name: Levitate
items.description: Sit cross-legged and float up off the ground, bobbing gently while glowing rune glyphs circle you.

items.name: Heart Toss
items.description: Bring a hand to your heart, then toss a little heart out to someone.

items.name: Kitty Pat
items.description: Kneel down and give a little white kitten a pat. It closes its eyes and swishes its tail.

items.name: Fire Ring
items.description: Strike a power pose with one fist raised while a ring of fire roars up around your feet.

items.name: Disco
items.description: Point up to the sky, then down to the floor, hips swinging to the beat while music notes float up.

items.name: Bring It
items.description: Plant your feet, chin up, and beckon with both hands. Come on, then.

items.name: Laugh
items.description: Clutch your sides, throw your head back and shake with laughter.

items.name: Hero Landing
items.description: Drop out of the air into a hero's crouch, one knee and one fist to the ground, dust bursting out around you.
